Health

Finance

Health

Finance

Career

Health
Switch off screens at least an hour before heading to bed. Your mind needs to wind down to ensure a deep and genuinely restorative night's rest.
Finance
You will receive welcome news regarding an outstanding payment you had almost written off. Handle this unexpected windfall sensibly, putting a portion aside for contingencies.

CANCER
Love

Career

Health
Take care of your digestive system by opting for light, warm meals packed with essential nutrients. A cup of chamomile tea after dinner will do wonders tonight.
Finance
Prioritise household expenses and postpone non-essential purchases. Your bank balance will greatly appreciate this financial discipline over the coming autumn weeks.

LEO
Love
Your generosity and warmth will thoroughly captivate your romantic partner. Express your devotion through thoughtful gestures that deepen mutual trust.
Career
You will take charge of a challenging project with flawless flair. Your motivational leadership will inspire enthusiasm, helping the team hit targets swiftly.

Your back needs extra attention; mind your posture throughout your daily tasks. Take active breaks to stretch your muscles and refresh your vitality.
Finance

Mercury External order will bring you serenity and clarity of mind.
VIRGO
Love
Avoid being overly critical of your partner's minor lapses today. Show your understanding side, and you will uncover a deeply affectionate dynamic in your bond.
Career
Your analytical acumen will allow you to pinpoint a critical flaw in a report. Prompt rectification will avert delays and cement your reputation as an immaculate professional.
Health
Incorporate deep breathing techniques to ease tension held in your stomach. A gentle evening stroll will help clear repetitive thoughts.
Finance
Examine recent bills thoroughly to rule out incorrect charges. Meticulous bookkeeping will provide the financial reassurance you require to move forward.
Venus Seek harmony in every choice you make.
LIBRA
Love
Diplomacy will help you resolve a minor romantic misunderstanding constructively. If you are single, a meaningful glance could spark promising chemistry.
Career
Your mediating talent will defuse lingering rivalry among colleagues. You will foster a collaborative climate where your creative proposals are warmly embraced.
Health
Hydrate your skin and drink plenty of water throughout the day. Balancing busy spells with quiet moments will enhance your overall wellbeing.
Finance
An appealing opportunity will arise to share costs or make a joint purchase on favourable terms. Check the agreements thoroughly to ensure fairness for both parties.
Pluto Transform challenges into sources of genuine power.
SCORPIO
Love
A passionate conversation will uncover shared secrets, deepening your romantic bond. Allow yourself to be vulnerable today and you will experience a transformative connection with your partner.
Career
Your perseverance will enable you to solve a workplace conundrum that others have sidestepped. Your strategic outlook will make a formidable impression on senior executives.
Health
Practise yoga or meditation to release stored emotional tension from the body. Recharging your mental energy will restore a deep sense of strength and vitality.
Finance
Maintain discretion regarding financial arrangements currently in the pipeline. Keep your monetary strategies under wraps until contracts are signed and sealed.
Jupiter Your optimism will propel you towards promising new horizons.
SAGITTARIUS
Love
A good sense of humour will turn an everyday occurrence into a memorable moment. Share your aspirations with your partner, or broaden your horizons by meeting people from different cultures.
Career
Your expansive vision will inspire a development plan that is warmly welcomed. Dare to propose innovative methods to boost your team's overall performance.
Health
Spending time in nature will revive your spirits and shake off lingering fatigue. Spend the afternoon walking in a park to regain a sense of freedom.
Finance
An opportunity to undertake training or educational travel could yield significant long-term rewards. Regard investment in learning as something that will pay dividends down the line.
Saturn Steady discipline builds the most enduring achievements.
CAPRICORN
Love
Show your affection through practical gestures and dependable, reassuring commitment. Your emotional stability will offer immense reassurance to someone who matters deeply to you.
Career
Your tireless graft will begin to bear long-awaited fruit. You will receive praise from management for the outstanding calibre of your professional output.
Health
Protect your joint health with gentle mobilisation and warm-up exercises. A deep-tissue massage will ease stiffness gathered in your shoulders.
Finance
A conservative approach will shield you from hasty or overly risky financial moves. Build up your emergency fund to face the upcoming quarters with complete peace of mind.
Uranus Your originality will make a bright, positive difference.
AQUARIUS
Love
Mutual freedom and respect will notably reinforce your romantic bond. If you are getting to know someone new, your forward-looking perspective will prove alluring.
Career
You will put forward an inventive solution to a problem that seemed deadlocked. Your knack for innovation will make you an indispensable asset to any project.
Health
Aid leg circulation by avoiding long spells of sedentary work. Regular stretching and brief walks will keep your physical wellbeing in top form.
Finance
You may be invited to collaborate on a tech venture or charitable project. Weigh up the financial implications before committing your resources today.
Neptune Trust the wisdom that springs from the heart.
PISCES
Love
Your empathy will allow you to intuitively understand your partner's emotional needs. This close bond will create moments of deep affection to treasure.
Career
Artistic flair will add a distinctive and rewarding dimension to your work. Let imagination guide you through tasks calling for sensitivity and originality.
Health
Spend time near water or enjoy a warm, relaxing bath this evening. You will feel tension melt away, paving the way for a sweet and restful night.
Finance
Be wary of financial promises that sound too good to be true. Consult a trusted confidant before lending money to anyone today.

item.content:encoded:
C.D. Leganés and La Joya have reached an agreement to renew their sponsorship partnership for the 2026–27 season, thereby strengthening a relationship based on mutual trust and a commitment to the club.
Thanks to this agreement, La Joya will continue to be part of the C.D. Leganés family as the club’s official sponsor during the current season, maintaining a prominent presence at Ontime Butarque Stadium and in various initiatives organized by the club.
Among the initiatives included in this renewal, La Joya will have advertising space on the stadium’s LED screens during first-team matches at Ontime Butarque. Additionally, it will continue to provide a ham-carving service in the VIP box, adding value to the experience of the club’s guests and partners on every match day.
A partnership that will extend to various events organized by the club
The partnership will also extend to various events organized by C.D. Leganés throughout the season, strengthening the brand’s visibility and its connection with the “Pepinera” fan base. Similarly, both organizations will work together on new initiatives set to launch soon within the club’s Fan Zone.
C.D. Leganés President Eduardo Cosín stated that they are “very happy to once again have La Joya on board; they are part of the family that supports us day in and day out. They seek moments and experiences, and we share the desire to bring joy and spend time together—and doing so for another year with them is a source of joy for us.”
The partnership aims to continue creating valuable experiences for fans
For his part, José Quintana, La Joya’s ambassador, said he was “very happy to be here for the second consecutive year. This year gives us the opportunity to continue participating in events and reaching a young audience, and we’re very happy to be able to continue for another year.”
With this renewal, C.D. Leganés and La Joya are solidifying a partnership that will continue to grow throughout the 2026–27 season, with the goal of continuing to create meaningful experiences for fans, sponsors, and members of the blue-and-white family.
